in_sanskrit.name: भाग्यराज
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who rules over the best of fortunes. The one who is the lord of happiness and prosperity.

in_hindi.name: भाग्यराज
in_hindi.long_meaning: The king of acquisitions. One who has gained or acquired a great deal.

in_tamil.name: பாக்கியராஜ்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The king of good fortune. The one who is the ruler of prosperity.

in_telugu.name: భాజ్యరాజ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who rules over prosperity and good fortune. The one who is the lord of wealth and happiness.

in_marathi.name: Bhagyaraj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhagyaraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhagya means fortune or prosperity, Raja means king. Thus, Bhagyaraj is a name that signifies a person who is blessed with good fortune and prosperity. This name is derived from Sanskrit and is commonly used in Hindu culture.
